<entry id="O00718">
<head-word>סִימְפּוֹן</head-word>
<head-word>סִמְ'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= סנפון; סָנַף) [
<italic>ramification, interweaving</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>ramified blood-vessel, artery; bronchiae</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Meg. I, 71
<sup>c</sup> bot. היה עשוי כמין ס' if the writing was done in the shape of arteries (furcated); cmp. חֲלִיטָה I.—Ḥull. 49
<sup>a</sup> (expl. בית הסימפונות, v. infra) ס' גדול the main branch (of the aorta); a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. סִימְפּוֹנוֹת, סִמְ'</plural-form>. Ib. III, 1 עד שתינקב לבית הס' until the perforation of the lungs reaches the starting point of the ramified blood-vessels (v. supra), expl. ib. 45
<sup>b</sup> להיכא דשפכי ס' כולהו into which all the vessels discharge themselves.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>cross-writing</italic>,] 
<italic>postscript to a document, codicil, conditions</italic> or 
<italic>modifications attached to a deed; receipt in full or in part.</italic> Y. Gitt. VII, end, 49
<sup>a</sup>; Y. Kidd. III, 64
<sup>a</sup> top; Y. Erub III, 21
<sup>b</sup> top סדר ס' כך הוא וכ' this is the formula of a 
<italic>simpon</italic> (of betrothal), I—betroth thee—, with the condition that I marry thee on a certain day, and if that day arrives and I fail to marry thee, I shall have no claim &c. Ib.</definition>
<notes> ירדו לס' בשיטת וכ' they entered into a conditional agreement in accordance with the principle of R. M. &c. (i.e. stating both alternatives), v. תְּנַאי. Y. B. Mets. X, 17
<sup>c</sup> ס' כתוב מלעיל וס' וכ' if one postscript is written at the top of the document, and one effaced at the bottom. B. Mets. I, 8 (20
<sup>a</sup>) אם יש עמהן ס' יעשה מה שבס' Y. ed. a. Ms. M. (Bab. a. Mish. ed. 
<italic>pl.</italic>) if a postscript is attached to the documents, you must be guided by the postscript. Ib. 20
<sup>b</sup> ס' היוצא וכ' a postscript (receipt to a note) produced by the creditor. Ib. 21
<sup>a</sup> ס' שיש עליו עדים a receipt signed by witnesses; a. fr.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as ab. B. Mets. I, 8, v. supra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>an implicit condition the non-fulfillment of which annuls the agreement</italic>, whence, 
<italic>a bodily defect</italic> (of a woman or a slave) 
<italic>not stated in the contract</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 57
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. משום ס' because a bodily defect may be detected before marriage, which would annul the betrothal. Ib. ס' בעבדים ליכא a bodily defect detected in a slave does not affect the validity of the purchase. Kidd. 10
<sup>b</sup> ולא חיישת לס' do you not take into consideration the possibility of finding a bodily defect by which the betrothal might be annulled?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="O00737">
<head-word>סִינַי</head-word>
<pos> pr. n.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) (הר) ס' 
<italic>Mount Sinai</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 89
<sup>a</sup>, v. סִימָנַאי. Shebu. 47
<sup>a</sup> (expl. חזרה השבועה למקומה, ib. VII, 4) חזרה … לס' the oath (which ought to have been administered to one of the contestants) goes back to Sinai, i.e. the case is referred to Divine Justice that proclaimed from Sinai, ‘thou shalt not rob’, on which all Israelites are sworn. Ib. 22
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. מושבע ועומד מהר ס' הוא does he not stand sworn (not to eat it) from Mount Sinai? Macc. 22
<sup>a</sup> לא קא חלה … מושבע ועומד מהר ס' הוא the oath (not to plough on the Holy Day) takes no effect, because he stands sworn &c. Ab. I, 1 משה קבל תורה מס' Moses received the Law from Sinai (by revelation); a. v. fr.—הלכה למשה מס', v. הֲלָכָה.—Sot. 21
<sup>a</sup> דרשיה … כי ס' R. M. interpreted that verse (Cant. VIII, 7) like a revelation; Arakh. 30
<sup>b</sup>.—Trnsf. 
<italic>erudite scholar</italic>. Hor. 14
<sup>a</sup>, opp. to עוקר הרים (v. הַר) dialectician; Ber. 64
<sup>a</sup>. M. Kat. 12
<sup>a</sup> ס' אמר הלכה וכ' Sinai (R. Joseph) has said &c. (and you dare to differ?).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup> סִיכַּכְנוּ על וכ' we covered a stable with them. Lam. R. to I, 17 (ref. to בסך, Ps. XLII, 5) לשעבר … ואילנות מְסַכְּכוֹת וכ' formerly I went up (to Jerusalem) with trees forming shades over my head; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְסוּכָּךְ; f. מְסוּכֶּכֶת. Succ. 8
<sup>b</sup> ובלבד שתהא מס' וכ' provided the Succah is covered according to law. Gen. R. s. 42 (ref. to עמק סכות, Ps. LX, 8) עמק שהוא מס' וכ' the valley which is shaded with trees. B. Bath. 25
